title: Yes, Probably. No, Definitely.
summary: A Bloom filter is certain when it says no and guessing when it says yes. Step through one key at a time and watch the maybes appear.

sources.title: Burton H. Bloom, Space/Time Trade-offs in Hash Coding with Allowable Errors (CACM, 1970)
Broder and Mitzenmacher, Network Applications of Bloom Filters: A Survey
Bose et al., On the false-positive rate of Bloom filters
